# cranky goblin

Cranky goblin is a muted, low-contrast dark theme in moss-grey tones with faint, fungus-like glows meant to stay restful over long sessions. It uses compact, pixel-leaning accents and the retro pixel fonts Lower Pixel for text and PixelWarden for headings.

![cranky goblin screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/incantatem2/Obsidian-cranky-goblin/HEAD/IMAGES/thumbnail.jpg)
